title: Add earlier EUR context geometry sources
changes: Add two independently authenticated eight-byte context geometry sources to the layered resource, retaining compatibility with six-record E144 datasets and leaving guest state and timing unchanged.
validation: Wine e145-geometry-retry-wine-umk6z87g preserves the E144 projection, checks 16 poisoned bytes and mixed-width boundaries, and matches three controlled original-helper cases. One ordinary target call matches one interpreter and one native-dispatch raw/managed state and clock with typed reads and no raw reads.

Wine e145-geometry-wine-3hvmtlai passed the preliminary source and helper checks but failed to find the ordinary target: its checkpoint was already in a later callback state. Original-code diagnosis identified a state-specific flag reused by another callback; the retry used the earlier state-1 checkpoint.
Wine e145-geometry-cli-wine-drenf7if passes production CLI create, no-write reuse, verification and one-frame startup; 102 other resource files match E144.

Wine e145-initial-wine-7x55zro_ observes both initial source calls during cold startup after English selection; one-frame interpreter/native-dispatch raw/managed pairs match state and clock with typed reads and no raw source reads.
limitations: Other consumers and scenes, per-read native attribution, frontend save/load, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
